dedupe_keys.name: ecoshape building with nature tools catalogue

description: EcoShape, the Dutch Building with Nature consortium, keeps a catalogue of about 30 tools that support nature-based hydraulic engineering projects in their initiation, planning and design, construction, and operation and maintenance phases. The list can be filtered by phase, by tool type (framework, hardware and software, method, model, software, web application) and by type of assessment (environmental economics, impact assessment, monitoring, system analysis). Tools on the page read include the Delft3D biogeomorphological coastal modelling system, the coastline intervention tool for the Holland coast, monitoring of coastal morphodynamics with satellite imagery, a nearshore wave transformation table for the Dutch coast, OpenEarth data management and viewer, DelftDashboard for quick model set-up from open databases, ArgusBio remote monitoring, Monte Carlo social cost-benefit analysis, and valuation of risks and opportunities in Building with Nature. Each tool page is free to read and links onward; no licence is stated for the catalogue. Caveats: the tools come from different partners and projects, with their own access terms and levels of upkeep. Coverage is the Netherlands and international projects. It supports design and assessment of green-blue coastal and river infrastructure; related records are the Sand Motor Delfland case study and the NetworkNature knowledge databases.
